translations: For Him (is the) dominion (of) the heavens
and the earth He gives life
puzzle.hint: This verse highlights Allah's absolute sovereignty, His control over life and death, and His power over all things.
puzzle.arabic: لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
puzzle.verseEn: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent.
